Spell Resistance +23: +23 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance.
Physical Sheltering +20: +20 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Embodiment of Law: Chaotic aligned characters equipping this item suffer a temporary negative level until the item is removed.
